body:
https://www.governor.virginia.gov/newsroom/news-releases/2022/september/name-939822-en.html

I tend to accept things like this - I know it isn't a statute reference. The release is dated 2022 but note that the link in the release is about a 2025 rebate. Some articles about the 2021 rebate include "up to" qualifications. This could refer to the limitation to tax  amount, or it could be a semi-secret phaseout. I don't know.

I have updated Taxsim to $250/$500 with eligible/paid to 2021/2022.
